why: owner 27 Nov: Call <pet name> is a hunter spell, not a miss; a player's name never reaches the npc miss list

ops.old: -- rc4: a line 1 that starts with a digit is a cost row ("107 Mana"), never a name
ops.new:
-- 1.1.8 (the owner's list: "Call silentecho" x33): a hunter's Call Pet spell carries the PET's
    -- own name ("Call <pet name>"), so no table can hold it: a one-word "Call X" of a hunter is
    -- "Call" in Persian + the pet's name, and it is never a miss
    if faName == nil and F.L and F.L.call_pet and not has_fa(name) then
        local pet = string.match(name, "^Call (%S+)$")
        if pet then
            local okc, _, cls = pcall(UnitClass, "player")
            if okc and cls == "HUNTER" then
                faName = F.L.call_pet .. " " .. pet
            end
        end
    end
    -- rc4: a line 1 that starts with a digit is a cost row ("107 Mana"), never a name

ops.old:
local isp = UnitIsPlayer(unit)
    if F.Usable(isp) and isp then
        return
    end
    -- 1.0.3:
ops.new:
local isp = UnitIsPlayer(unit)
    -- 1.1.8: a unit we cannot tell for sure is a player (a value the game hides) is never
    -- looked up and never logged: a player's name must not reach the NPC miss list
    if not F.Usable(isp) or isp then
        return
    end

ops.new:
